meta.name: Master of the House
meta.description: A family enters a power struggle following the death of their patriarch, who leaves behind his diamond empire — and the housekeeper he recently married.

videos.title: The Last Supper
videos.overview: The president of Theva Gems is found dead. Shortly before his passing, a startling announcement is made during his birthday dinner.

videos.title: The Offer
videos.overview: Kaimook has doubts about the circumstances surrounding her husband's death. Phupat makes the first move to assert his dominance at the family company.

videos.title: Achilles Heel
videos.overview: Kita prepares to unveil her upcoming fashion collection. Later, the family gathers as their lawyer reads out Mr. Roongroj's will.

videos.title: Death End
videos.overview: An unexpected incident leads to conflict within the family. New evidence suggests a suspect's involvement in Mr. Roongroj's death.

videos.title: Retribution
videos.overview: The power struggle between Phupat and Mavin intensifies. Padcha reluctantly makes an offer that could save Shutter.

videos.title: Rebellion
videos.overview: Phupat and Mavin experience a life-threatening incident. Meanwhile, a tightly kept secret shapes the future of the family company.

videos.title: Master of the House
videos.overview: In this flashback episode, Kaimook starts her tenure serving the Thevasatitpaisarn family — and meets Mr. Roongroj for the first time.

meta.slogan: Who Will Come Out on Top?
